name: Sabvest Capital Limited
summary: Sabvest Capital Limited is a private equity and venture capital firm specializing in early venture, mid venture, late venture, emerging growth, growth capital, special situation and management buyouts. It seeks to invest equity interests in listed and unlisted companies. It usually invests in companies where key management has meaningful interests or in family managed businesses. The firm does not invest in stage one, start-up or greenfield investments, and turnarounds and is also unlikely to make new investments that exceed 15% of its portfolio or 25% of shareholders' equity.
